title: Peptide Vial Labels with Detachable Record Tabs: Proof Both Identities
seoTitle: Detachable Record Tabs for Peptide Vial Labels | RP
description: Specify a custom vial wrap label and detachable record tab as one connected job: matched identifiers, peel force, die cut and applied proof.
alt: AI-generated RP Research branded research vials with a detachable label tab and a sample tracking card on a proof table
caption: AI-generated demonstration, not an approved traceability system. RP Research and DEMO 106 are fictional; matching tab behavior and print data require physical proof.
intro: A tear-off tab only saves time if the identity left on the vial and the identity moved to the record stay unambiguous.
sources: HERMA: vial labeling and detachable documentation labels

title: Peptide Vial Labels with a Clear Viewing Window: Keep the Vial Inspectable
seoTitle: Clear Viewing Windows on Peptide Vial Labels | RP
description: Plan a custom research vial label around a visible glass window without sacrificing product identity, lot data or reliable wrap application.
alt: AI-generated RP Research peptide sample vials with complete navy labels and a deliberate clear vertical viewing window
caption: AI-generated vial-window concept. Powder, lot DEMO 107 and QR-like art are fictional; no content, stability or scan performance was tested.
intro: An opaque wrap can make a small vial easy to brand and hard to inspect at the same time.
related: Choose clear film and white ink
sources: HERMA: vial labeling and fill-level markings
HERMA: label cut-outs that leave container contents visible
Avery Dennison: clear-film solutions for vial visibility

title: Supplement Label Claims: Freeze Reviewed Copy Before You Print
seoTitle: Supplement Label Claims Prepress Review | RP Labels
description: Keep custom supplement label artwork out of reprint trouble by separating brand language, regulated claims, approved copy and final press files.
alt: AI-generated RP Wellness supplement bottle and complete label proof beside an unchecked draft artwork review sheet
caption: AI-generated draft review scene. RP Wellness, the formula, label copy and any Facts-style text are fictional and have not received regulatory or print approval.
intro: A late claim edit can change the front panel, disclaimer space and approval trail after the label size has already been quoted.
sources: FDA: structure/function and related claim notifications

title: Supplement Facts on Dark Bottles: Proof the Opaque Information Panel
seoTitle: Supplement Facts on Dark Bottles | Label Proof Guide
description: A clear label over amber glass can weaken small-copy contrast. Compare an opaque neutral Facts panel on the actual bottle before ordering the run.
alt: AI-generated RP Wellness amber supplement bottles comparing a transparent label concept with an opaque light information panel
caption: AI-generated contrast comparison only. The visible ingredients, claims, quantities and Facts figures are fictional and are not compliant artwork.
intro: A premium clear-on-amber look can make the front attractive while the required small print becomes difficult to read.
sources: FDA: Supplement Facts presentation and contrast
FDA: general label legibility and contrast
Avery Dennison: clear film labels for rigid containers

title: Hologram Labels with Scratch-Off Codes: Specify the Data Handoff
seoTitle: Hologram Scratch-Off Code Label Buying Guide | RP
description: Before ordering custom holographic labels with hidden codes, agree who generates identifiers, how codes are concealed and how a sample is verified.
alt: AI-generated RP Secure hologram stickers with a partially revealed demo scratch-off code and matching sample data handoff sheet
caption: AI-generated DRAFT security-label concept. RP-DEMO-108 and hidden code 7B4K9 are fictional examples; no live authentication database or scratch durability test exists.
intro: A hidden code is not a verification program until the printed mark, code file and response system can be reconciled.
sources: GS1: digital signatures and authentication codes in physical markings
